elements.label: Figure 8.1
elements.title: Balancing the ethical aspects of the evolving practice of data science requires a careful approach throughout the data science cycle (i.e., during collection, analysis, and use of data, as well as its dissemination).
elements.details: Image shows a digital background of numbers in blue and green with a large red unlocked padlock icon overlayed in the center, symbolizing data security and privacy concerns.
elements.summary: This image visually represents the concept of balancing ethical considerations in data science, emphasizing the importance of security and privacy throughout the data science cycle.
